content: MVR-xchange: stations join a shared 'group' on local network (mDNS discovery) or via a wss:// coordinating server for internet use; TCP or WebSocket transport. Sharing a new MVR version notifies connected stations, which can pull and apply it. Supported by BlenderDMX, Vectorworks Spotlight, grandMA3, Production Assist, zactrack, Araneo Studio. This is a live push/pull sync protocol for whole-scene MVR files, not per-attribute sync.
